# per fixture: the file name, then one float32 per 1280-sample chunk as
# a hexadecimal bit pattern, in order.
#
# Produced by record_reference.py against openwakeword 0.4.0 on ONNX
# Runtime 1.28.0 from PyPI, with the hey_jarvis_v0.1 head. Regenerate
# whenever the corpus changes; the two are a matched pair and neither
# means anything without the other.
#
# The port is held to these within 1e-6, not bit for bit. It links a
# different BUILD of ONNX Runtime 1.28.0, and two builds do not agree on
# float rounding across different SIMD paths. The bound, the measured
# floor beneath it and the injected faults above it are all recorded in
# tests/wake_equivalence.rs.
#
# Bit patterns rather than decimal text, and the tolerance is why this
# matters more rather than less: decimal round-tripping between two
# languages would quietly eat part of a margin only 3x wide.
